framework.name: CyberStrikeAI
framework.source_provisioning: official shallow clone made inside a Docker-managed Linux volume; no Windows host-path mount

time_utc.source: operator-observed Docker CLI logs, top, inspect, and events collected at finalization time
time_utc.precision_limit: Docker event timestamps are rounded to milliseconds in this shared record; no running-process snapshot exists because the container had already exited.

environment.writable_runtime_volume: Docker-managed source/log volume only; no host path
environment.external_egress: not available through internal Docker network

execution_scope.allowed_action: framework startup and loopback-only health observation

outcome.reason: The framework emitted its startup telemetry, then its Pi runtime build failed. Docker events recorded exit code 1 after 141 seconds. The service was not restarted; loopback health was not attempted after exit, and docker top confirmed there was no running process.
outcome.controlled_stop: not invoked because the container was already stopped; the stopped container and all Docker volumes were retained
outcome.label: startup_and_local_failure_lifecycle_not_behavioral
